blocks.title: Work with Feishu from a Vetta conversation
blocks.description: Give the agent the official lark-cli command surface for documents, messages, calendars, Base, tasks and other supported Feishu domains.

blocks.content: Enabling this ability installs the latest official @larksuite/cli package. After installation, Vetta opens a QR setup flow so you can create or connect a Feishu app. The App Secret is saved by lark-cli and is not displayed by Vetta.

showcase.user_prompt: Summarize the Feishu document I linked and turn the action items into tasks.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll inspect the relevant official lark-cli skill, read the document through the CLI, then create the requested tasks and report what changed.

items.title: Direct CLI access
items.description: The agent uses lark-cli through its existing shell. There is no extra Vetta Action, MCP server or custom agent tool.

items.title: Upstream skills stay current
items.description: A thin Vetta skill tells the agent to discover and read the skills embedded in the installed official CLI instead of copying them into this plugin.

items.title: Guided app setup
items.description: Installation stages and the exact opaque setup URL are surfaced on this page, including a scannable QR code and browser fallback.

items.title: Install and enable
items.description: Confirm this ability’s permissions. Vetta then checks for lark-cli and runs the official installer only when it is missing.

items.title: Scan the setup QR code
items.description: Create or connect a Feishu app in the official flow. Keep the dialog open until lark-cli confirms completion.

items.title: Ask Vetta to work in Feishu
items.description: The agent discovers the matching official CLI skill and runs the relevant lark-cli commands from its shell.
